title: 16 face criminal complaints over MV June Aster fire that killed 77
summary: The Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) has filed criminal complaints against 16 individuals in connection with the fire aboard passenger vessel MV June Aster in Coron, Palawan, which killed 77 people.
